answer: Bind each agent to one unique ISP last-mile circuit in a public carrier atlas. Epoch challenges demand signed traceroute and BGP-origin echoes from that circuit ASN; clones on one pipe collide and slash. Shared circuits hit the nadir of weight. A juniper grove of peer beacons cross-checks ASN honesty at the network wharf. Attacker cost ≈ 1000 separately billed always-on ISP circuits.
